title: Version 0.6.0 - Absol, Bots and Lane Picking
message: Latest version: 0.6.0 Absol joins the roster, bots are now available in every supported mode, and lane picking is now available in character select. This update also reworks EXP sharing to fit the original game, adds healing tracking and spatial audio, and includes a large batch of bug fixes. New Pokemon: Absol - Added Absol as a playable character. - All movesets are available Bots - Added bots to custom Remoat Stadium and Theia Sky Ruins lobbies, as well as Electrode Volleyball, Psyduck Racing and Unite Royale. - Hosts can use Add Bots and Clear Bots in the lobby, and individual bots can be removed. - Bots will fill empty lanes and take part in blind pick and draft. Lane picking - During character select on Remoat Stadium and Theia Sky Ruins, choose Top Path, Central Area or Bottom Path. - You can change your lane until the match loads. Bots fill any lanes left open around human choices. Major gameplay changes - EXP sharing reworked: the system for splitting exp on wild pokemons has been reworked to be the same as the original game's. - Post-match Battle Data now tracks healing done. Ally healing, self-healing, lifesteal, spell vamp and item healing count; overhealing, shields and environmental healing do not. - Reworked spatial audio: gameplay sounds now fade based on their position on screen and remain filtered by vision and team visibility. - Reworked the goal zone shield with a new shader for better performance. - Lobby-to-character-select transitions are now synchronized between players. Trainer previews load independently with placeholders, so slow loads no longer hold up the match. Character changes Sylveon - Swift's projectile hitbox size increased. - Fairy Frolic now shows a ground warning during the airborne wind-up. Glaceon - Fixed Glaceon's Unite zone continuing to apply buffs, debuffs and damage after it ended or despawned. - Fixed Icicle Spear sometimes failing to spawn or leaving a stale hitbox. Flareon - Fixed Flareon's combo and recast state persisting after death or despawn. Duraludon - Fixed Duraludon's cannon mode camera overriding jump-pad and other camera effects. Mode changes Psyduck Racing - Fixed bugs on all six Psyduck racing moves: Barrier, Bubbles, Confuse Ray, Freeze Ray, Shield and Dash. - Fixed race standings and finish handling when players disconnect. Unite Royale - Fixed trainer companions getting stuck in the wrong animation after their clothes finished loading. Bug fixes and quality of life - Fixed goal zones granting speed and shields when weakened or when no living defender was present. - Fixed vision and brush state persisting after respawn or teleport. - Fixed Flux Zone speed bonuses remaining after leaving the zone or after the zone was disabled. - Fixed AEOS energy drops spawning above the ground. - Fixed wild Pokemon failing to spawn or navigate correctly. - Fixed jump pad selection, camera overrides and movement locks, including when a player dies or disconnects during a jump. - Fixed minimap icons persisting after a KO or despawn, and objective icons not cleaning up. - Fixed missing objective KO notifications and stale kill notifications after a target despawns. - Fixed the results screen score animation and team score tracking. - Added a proper connection-error dialog. Lobbies and quick join now check the game version and show a clear error for incompatible builds. - Controller gameplay now hides the mouse cursor after two seconds of inactivity. - Player names are now remembered between sessions. - Android: added high-refresh-rate support at the device's current resolution. - Optimized HUD, minimap and status-effect updates to improve performance. On certain platforms the player clothes may take more time to load. Thank you for downloading this game, welcome to the my unite recreation! As this is an early build bugs are expected and 100% going to happen, if you find any please report them in my discord server (link in the itch page) Currently not every feature from the original is implemented, here's a list of features that are missing and planned to be added: - More settings options - Other things i may have missed But why should you play this? Idk at least you can't get slowbro united here. Jokes aside this is mainly so my concepts can actually be played. 27/10/2026: And also so this may act as a preservation project for the now EoS UNITE If quick join or ranked isn't finding any match it's likely that there are no open rooms at the moment, in that case i suggest you create an open room yourself. Lastly i hope you enjoy the experience and have some fun! Made with passion by JustMarcy (Of course the original game is owned by Timi studios, this project was purely made for educational purposes and does not intend to replace in any way the original)
